# The Corpus — Lazy Atlas build

This site uses a lightweight Atlas metadata index (`atlas-data.js`) and loads
full poem text from `data/atlas/chunks/` only when a reader opens an entry.

## Local preview

Serve the folder over HTTP; do not open `index.html` directly:

```cmd
py -m http.server 8000
```

Then open `http://localhost:8000/`.

## Generated files

The following files are generated by the package-level builder and should not be
edited manually:

- `atlas-data.js`
- `data/atlas/manifest.json`
- `data/atlas/chunks/atlas-*.json`
- `reports/atlas-build-report.json`
- `reports/removed-synthetic.json`
- `reports/skipped-duplicates.json`

Run `BUILD-WINDOWS.cmd` from the package root to regenerate them.
